text:
The evidence shows tree-cover loss, not confirmed deforestation. Hansen/UMD mapped about 0.7 ha of tree-cover loss in 2023 (1.2% of the 58.1 ha asset). The method corroborated it: later years were observed, and the JRC 2020 map shows forest across the whole event area.

The MGAP 2021 map suggests this was mostly planted forest, not native forest. About 0.4 ha is planted eucalyptus and 0.3 ha is outside mapped forest, with no native forest. This is context only, not a cause. Cutting a plantation counts as tree-cover loss in Hansen data, so the loss may not be deforestation.

The evidence does not establish deforestation or land-use change, the cause (harvest, fire, clearing), legality, who was responsible, or any compliance status. A further 0.4 ha of loss in patches under 0.5 ha was not counted as an event.
